1001.name: ErrGetMeshsyncCode
1001.short_description: Unable to get the MeshSync resource
1001.probable_cause: The MeshSync custom resource was deleted, or operator RBAC denies get/list/watch on meshsyncs
1001.suggested_remediation: Confirm the MeshSync CR exists and that the operator's ClusterRole grants get/list/watch on meshsyncs.meshery.io

1002.name: ErrCreateMeshsyncCode
1002.short_description: Unable to create the MeshSync workload
1002.probable_cause: The MeshSync Deployment or its owned objects could not be created
1002.suggested_remediation: Check the operator RBAC for deployments and inspect the events in the MeshSync namespace

1003.name: ErrReconcileMeshsyncCode
1003.probable_cause: Broker configuration, workload deployment, or the health check failed for MeshSync
1003.suggested_remediation: Check the MeshSync status conditions and the operator logs for the failing reconcile step

1004.name: ErrGetBrokerCode
1004.short_description: Unable to get the Broker resource
1004.probable_cause: The Broker custom resource was deleted, or operator RBAC denies get/list/watch on brokers
1004.suggested_remediation: Confirm the Broker CR exists and that the operator's ClusterRole grants get/list/watch on brokers.meshery.io

1005.name: ErrCreateBrokerCode
1005.short_description: Unable to create the Broker workload
1005.probable_cause: The NATS StatefulSet, Service, or ConfigMaps could not be created
1005.suggested_remediation: Check the operator RBAC and inspect the events on the owned objects in the broker namespace

1006.name: ErrReconcileBrokerCode
1006.probable_cause: The NATS StatefulSet, Service, or ConfigMaps could not be created or updated
1006.suggested_remediation: Check the operator RBAC and inspect the events on the owned objects in the broker namespace

1007.name: ErrReconcileCRCode
1007.probable_cause: A reconcile step failed for the custom resource
1007.suggested_remediation: Check the operator logs for the underlying cause; the controller will requeue and retry

1008.name: ErrDeleteMeshsyncCode
1008.short_description: Unable to delete the MeshSync workload
1008.probable_cause: Owned MeshSync objects could not be deleted during finalization
1008.suggested_remediation: Inspect the MeshSync finalizers and confirm the operator RBAC grants delete on deployments

1009.name: ErrDeleteBrokerCode
1009.short_description: Unable to delete the Broker workload
1009.probable_cause: Owned broker objects could not be deleted during finalization
1009.suggested_remediation: Inspect the Broker finalizers and confirm the operator RBAC grants delete on statefulsets, services, and configmaps

1010.name: ErrCheckHealthCode
1010.probable_cause: The StatefulSet or Deployment has not reached its desired ReadyReplicas
1010.suggested_remediation: Inspect the pod status and events for the workload; the controller will requeue and retry

1011.name: ErrGetEndpointCode
1011.short_description: Unable to derive the broker endpoint
1011.probable_cause: The broker Service has no reachable internal or external address yet
1011.suggested_remediation: Verify the broker Service exists and has assigned ports and an address; LoadBalancer addresses may still be pending

1012.name: ErrUpdateResourceCode
1012.probable_cause: A status patch or resource update conflicted or was rejected by the API server
1012.suggested_remediation: Check for concurrent writers and confirm the operator RBAC grants update on the resource and its status; the controller will retry

1013.name: ErrGettingBrokerResourceCode
1013.short_description: Unable to get a broker-owned resource
1013.probable_cause: The broker StatefulSet, Service, or ConfigMap lookup failed
1013.suggested_remediation: Check the operator RBAC and confirm the resource exists in the broker namespace

1014.name: ErrBrokerReplicasNotReadyCode
1014.probable_cause: The NATS StatefulSet has not reached its desired ReadyReplicas
1014.suggested_remediation: Inspect the StatefulSet pod status and events; the controller will requeue and retry

1015.name: ErrBrokerConditionFalseCode
1015.short_description: A broker readiness condition is false
1015.probable_cause: A required status condition on the broker workload reports False
1015.suggested_remediation: Inspect the broker status conditions for the reported reason

1016.name: ErrGettingBrokerEndpointCode
1016.short_description: Unable to get the broker endpoint
1016.probable_cause: The broker Service is not yet reachable or has no assigned address
1016.suggested_remediation: Verify the broker Service and its ports; a pending LoadBalancer address resolves on a later reconcile

1017.name: ErrMarshalCode
1017.probable_cause: The custom resource could not be serialized for a status patch
1017.suggested_remediation: This indicates a defect in the status builder; please report it with the operator logs

1018.name: ErrGettingMeshsyncResourceCode
1018.short_description: Unable to get a MeshSync-owned resource
1018.suggested_remediation: Check the operator RBAC and confirm the Deployment exists in the MeshSync namespace

1019.name: ErrMeshsyncReplicasNotReadyCode
1019.probable_cause: The MeshSync Deployment has not reached its desired ReadyReplicas
1019.suggested_remediation: Inspect the Deployment pod status and events; the controller will requeue and retry

1020.name: ErrMeshsyncConditionFalseCode
1020.short_description: A MeshSync readiness condition is false
1020.probable_cause: A required status condition on the MeshSync workload reports False
1020.suggested_remediation: Inspect the MeshSync status conditions for the reported reason

1021.name: ErrGettingMeshsyncEndpointCode
1021.short_description: Unable to get the MeshSync broker endpoint
1021.probable_cause: The broker referenced by the MeshSync spec has no resolvable endpoint
1021.suggested_remediation: Verify the native broker CR or the custom broker URL configured in the MeshSync spec

1022.name: ErrCleanupBrokerCode
1022.short_description: Unable to clean up obsolete Broker resources
1022.probable_cause: The operator could not inspect or delete obsolete broker workloads and services during an upgrade
1022.suggested_remediation: Inspect the Broker Cleanup condition and operator logs, and confirm RBAC permits listing MeshSync deployments and deleting broker StatefulSets and Services

1024.name: ErrInvalidServiceAccountNameCode
1024.probable_cause: The MESHSYNC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT environment variable on the meshery-operator Deployment is not a valid Kubernetes ServiceAccount name (a DNS-1123 subdomain)
1024.suggested_remediation: Set MESHSYNC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT to the ServiceAccount MeshSync should run under (meshery-meshsync for the meshery-operator chart and config/default), or unset it to use the operator's own ServiceAccount
